assignment: maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching, minimum total initial distance on ties; no future rematching
ensemble_mean: normalized Cartesian unit-vector mean on the sphere

heatmap.latitude_edges: integers -90 through 90; north pole in last cell
heatmap.event: at least one tracked cyclone center in cell per member and time

aggregation: position error on common storm/lead pairs; REV from date-averaged confusion matrices before maximizing over decision thresholds
conventions_note: Assignment tie handling, sphere radius, mean coordinate convention and heatmap origin are explicit choices where paper prose does not fully specify implementation.
